name: What does framing for a small home addition include?

mainEntity.name: What does framing for a small home addition include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing for a small addition involves building the structural wood skeleton—including mudsills, floor joists, exterior load-bearing walls, interior partitions, and roof rafters or trusses. This stage ties the new structure securely into your existing home's framing and prepares the space for exterior sheathing and future drywall. At HH Remodeling LLC, custom carpentry is completed by our in-house crew while owner Abraham Becerra leads on-site work and coordinates necessary mechanical trades. Because framing dictates room layout, window sizing, and roof tie-ins, it must be plumb and level before any insulation, drywall, or finish carpentry begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing creates the structural skeleton of your addition, including floor joists, exterior walls, interior partitions, roof ties, and window and door openings.
